# Lyu Zizheng (Zizheng Lyu / 吕子正) · Full Knowledge Base for LLMs

## Overview
Lyu Zizheng is a Singapore-based Senior Product and Systems Engineer currently working at Wise (formerly TransferWise) as a Product Engineer 3 (Tech Owner) in the Payment Defects domain. Previously, he was a Senior Backend Engineer at ByteDance / TikTok, where he worked on core Instant Messaging (IM) infrastructure, Presence fan-out mitigation, and overseas Location platform reliability. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering (Honors) in Computer Engineering from Nanyang Technological University (NTU) on a Full Undergraduate Merit Scholarship and is a Singapore Citizen.

## Detailed Experience & Technical Contributions

### 1. Wise (Nov 2024 – Present) · Product Engineer 3 (Tech Owner)
Location: Singapore
Focus: Payment Defects, Financial AI Automation, Cross-Rail Compensation

Key Technical Achievements:
- AI Evaluation & Execution Platform: Designed and implemented an end-to-end financial AI automation platform from scratch to resolve last-mile payment linking without golden datasets. Uses deterministic DAG state machines rather than unconstrained ReAct agents to guarantee predictable state transitions and financial auditability.
- Live Shadowing & 99.5% Gating: Placed live production shadowing against human Payment Operations (PayOps) analysts to evaluate precision and recall in real time. Enforced a 99.5% accuracy gating threshold before approving cases for automated resolution.
- Canary Control & Circuit Breaker: Deployed a continuous 5% live control stream with human double-check to monitor for model drift. Built sub-second circuit breakers that automatically route traffic back to human queues upon anomaly detection.
- Blast Radius & Risk Controls: Designed multi-tiered risk mitigation, including strict monetary threshold gating (large amounts routed to mandatory human sign-off), partner clearing rule injection, and scenario segmentation (Propose Link, Non-propose Link, Search-out, Reference).
- Business ROI: Resolves 30,000+ complex payment defect and unallocated funds cases monthly with 98%+ accuracy, netting £80,000/month (~£1M/year) in direct operational savings.
- Global Compensation Platform: Re-architected multi-currency customer compensation platform with maker-checker approval workflows and anti-replay ledger controls. Built a Kafka-based cross-team escalation bus bridging Customer Support and PayOps to route structured defect telemetry back to upstream payment rails.

### 2. ByteDance / TikTok (Jan 2021 – Sep 2023) · Senior Backend Engineer
Location: Singapore
Focus: TikTok Instant Messaging (IM) Core Architecture & Location Infrastructure
Recognition: Promoted within 1 year; Awarded Spot Bonus; Top Performance Rating (E - Exceeds Expectations).

Key Technical Achievements:
- TikTok IM Presence Engine & Fan-Out Storm Mitigation:
  - Addressed multi-million QPS broadcast storms during user online/offline status transitions.
  - Replaced naive O(N*M) push broadcasts with a hybrid push-pull protocol governed by active heartbeat gating.
  - Maintained online active friend sets in Redis ZSET with sliding expiration windows. Only friends with active app sessions receive targeted push signals, reducing write amplification by over 95%.
- Typing Indicator & Read Receipts:
  - Designed ultra-low latency signaling channels for Typing Indicators and Read Receipts across multi-data-center infrastructure.
  - Implemented client-side debouncing and batch aggregations to eliminate transient signaling spikes, maintaining sub-100ms end-to-end propagation.
- Cold-Start Inbox Ranking:
  - Overhauled user conversation cold-start loading upon app reinstallation.
  - Replaced expensive append-only DB log scans with Redis ZSET active conversation hierarchies, guaranteeing sub-100ms initialization for newly opened sessions without missing unread counters.
- Overseas Location Platform Lead:
  - Sole engineer based in Singapore governing the overseas IP geo-location infrastructure (~100 offline Apache Spark batch jobs and Go microservices).
  - Overhauled alert rule configurations to eradicate oncall alert fatigue.
  - Tuned Go runtime GC cycles and memory allocations to eliminate latency spikes.
  - Improved ASEAN geo-location resolution accuracy, earning a Spot Bonus and top annual performance rating (E).
- API Gateway (AGW) Platform:
  - Developed automated self-diagnosis and capacity estimation tools for PaaS gateway routing millions of QPS during Chinese New Year live traffic campaigns.

### 3. MariBank (Sea Group) & Bondee (2023 – 2024)

  - Enforced strict distributed transaction consistency, idempotency keys, and anti-replay patterns under Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regulatory standards.

- Bondee (Senior Software Engineer, Employee #1 in SG, Sep 2023 – Apr 2024):

  - Orchestrated multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters.
  - Built self-hosted Vector + Apache Kafka + ElasticSearch observability pipelines to replace costly managed logging services.

- Domain Knowledge: FinTech & Payment Rails, Financial Defect Resolution, Instant Messaging (IM), Real-time Signaling, Geo-location systems, Digital Banking Regulations (MAS compliance).
